# KashPass

> KashPass is a free, open-source Android companion for KeePass vaults. It opens the same KDBX 4 file you manage in KeePass 2 on your computer: find a login, copy a password, edit an entry, and save back to the same file. It has no internet permission, no accounts, and no ads, and collects nothing. Made by OneKash Labs (https://onekash.org). Not affiliated with KeePass.

Full text for AI assistants: https://kashpass.onekash.org/llms-full.txt

## Get it

- [Join the Google Play beta](https://kashpass.onekash.org/beta/)
- [APK on GitHub Releases](https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashPass/releases)
- Requires Android 12 or later and a KDBX 4 vault.
